inputs.ENABLE_PERMISSION: U6 pin9; qualified manual permission; one of two clear acknowledgements
inputs.PG_CONDITIONED: Legacy single-receiver output; insufficient alone for split left/right supply, not proof of both rails healthy
inputs.INDEPENDENT_HEALTH: stop/power/monitor validity excluding expected pre-start PG low
inputs.STARTUP_EXPIRED: timer not selected; deadline must satisfy startup and fault-energy bounds
inputs.ARMED: U6 pin5; release-qualified memory; must also be observed Low before clear completion
inputs.CLEAR_HOLD_DONE: unimplemented timing qualification at both actual U6 CLR pins; not instant acknowledgement
inputs.RESET_LOW_OBSERVED: unimplemented valid observation of actual reset assertion; invalidate after each new clear request
inputs.LEFT_SOURCE_VOLTAGE_VALID: Unimplemented independent UV/OV qualification upstream of left servo switch, including monitor power validity
inputs.RIGHT_SOURCE_VOLTAGE_VALID: Unimplemented independent UV/OV qualification upstream of right servo switch, including monitor power validity
inputs.LEFT_PG_VALID: Unimplemented qualified left switch status; distinguish startup low from RUN failure
inputs.RIGHT_PG_VALID: Unimplemented qualified right switch status; distinguish startup low from RUN failure

outputs.SEQUENCE_ENABLE_REQUEST: revF U3 pin4; true only START/RUN and healthy
outputs.SEQUENCE_CLEAR_REQUEST: revH U14 pin2 active High; driver not implemented; hold until complete clear contract satisfied

constraints: Fault memory does not continuously hold latch clear after acknowledgement
Minimum clear pulse and race analysis required
CLEAR completion requires healthy power, ARMED Low, ENABLE_PERMISSION Low, reset assertion observed, and minimum hold completed
Do not assign latch outputs Low in sequencer model as a substitute for hardware acknowledgement
Clear release must meet CLR-to-next-clock recovery/setup requirement
Per-request timer arming requires observed CLEAR_HOLD_DONE Low before accepting a fresh completion; prior High is not acknowledgement of a new request
START may begin only after both source-voltage qualifications and independent health are valid
RUN requires both leg PG inputs valid; single MAIN_EFUSE_PG is not sufficient
Either source-voltage qualification lost in START/RUN cancels sequence permission and requests remembered clear, irrespective of FLT
Either PG lost in RUN cancels both-leg sequence permission; normal pre-start PG low must not deadlock START
Voltage recovery alone cannot reissue permission; complete clear and a fresh release/press are required
split_supply_status: Required interface defined; voltage monitors, second PG receiver, capture timing and hardware logic unimplemented
